reviews.review_description:
Why are Meta allowing this?? A HUGE name in gaming, many players have been waiting for this. The game seems solid at its core, but this is a very, very badly optimized port. They haven’t added the textures for most things, they even left the button names for some other controller?? People will compare this “version “ to the others on the market, and the Meta Quest will once again get bad reviews. Meta!! Don’t allow this! Please. Your players deserve more. Transformers fans deserve more. And you are practically sabotaging your own platform with this. Not since Arashi Temples of sin(or whatever that Ninja game was called) has there been a worse and more DISRESPECT release. 
The meta quest 3 can actually run a decent version of this game. It’s a shame.

Shooting on rail is ok so far... except there is no option to play "sitting down" you need to be standing up... and dodge incoming fire by moving far to the left (several feet) you cant just lean on the side like most other VR game... also you actually need to crouch a lot... which i cant because of disabilities... beside of the trigger buttons none of the buttons or even joysticks are used on the controller... why cant i use these buttons to dodge and crouch... i thought...and hoped it wouldve been an actual rail shooter... instead its more of a exercise game where you cant play if you're disabled. Then the graphics are horrendous.... feels like playing a very old N64 game with washed out textures... it hurts the eyes. All the robots looks bad with a shiny coating. Am a huge fan of transformers but i cant recomend this game... specially for disabled people.

We’ve been so excited about this for months and it’s just a really bad knock off of an old school NES arcade game. Shoot these random bugs while Optimus maybe does something in the background. Epic fail.
Its good but I just really really wish the graphics were better
I love it bought it and completed the story day one (rest in peace peter cullen 🕊)

reviews.review_title: I was really looking forward to play
